entities.name: Climate Resilience and Spice Trade Revival
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Grenada's ongoing efforts to build climate resilience, revive the spice industry, and maintain its 'Spice Island' identity while adapting to increasingly severe weather patterns. The country remains the world's second-largest nutmeg producer after Indonesia.
